terms.gloss: shelf (for books, busts, things on display)
terms.comment: Classically a bookshelf or bookcase, with busts on it in Juvenal (see bookshelf); its other senses are a board, the back of a couch and a parapet. The modern works use it for any shelf.

terms.gloss: a set of shelves, a fitted bookcase
terms.comment: A wooden fixture of boards in a house (in the Digest it goes with the house when sold); in Cicero a bookcase. In Seneca and Suetonius also a stage machine that rose and fell.

phrases.english: Put the book back on the shelf.

sources: Lewis & Short: pluteus · Lewis & Short: pegma
